name: image-eyes
description: Remote MCP server that lets Claude see images from the web and from wikis

scripts.bundle:
esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// Image Eyes 3.0 — the whole connector in one file, for pasting into the Cloudflare dashboard (Workers & Pages → image-eyes → Edit code).
